_comment: Hand edits on top of the OpenStreetMap draft of København Nørreport (scripts/stations/draft_from_osm.py), BUILDOUT O5 batch 2 (2026-10-29). Drafted from OSM only so far; facts from DSB's or Banedanmark's station page, photos or a walk go here with their source. Level names are placeholders until a plan or signage names them.

changelog.what: First draft from OSM (BUILDOUT O5 batch 2).

Withheld after the final research pass: no numbered platforms (underground; OSM and Banedanmark's lines don't number them). The edits keep the research (platform heights, structures, entrances, amenities) for when OSM or a walk adds what's missing.
